newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai copper ends up on institutional support.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai copper ends up on institutional support.

text.p: Shanghai copper futures ended sharply up on Friday after big buying from institutional investors, traders said.

The most actively traded November 1997 contract ended at 21,570 yuan ($2,601) per tonne, rising 670 yuan. It opened at 21,200 yuan, hitting an intraday low of 21,150 and a high of 21,680 yuan per tonne.
August rose 400 to 21,000 yuan, September 400 to 21,200, October 620 to 21,520, December 680 to 21,580, the January 1997 contract 700 to 21,600 yuan per tonne.
